predicts: continuous minimum temperature (deg C) over the configured horizon
training_description: Tier-1 (European) data, cities: [BASEL, OSLO, PERPIGNAN, DE_BILT], train: 2000-01-01 to 2006-12-31, 1-day horizon, untuned CatBoost defaults (best result across all tuned/untuned configurations tried in this notebook).
known_limitations: Trained and evaluated on Tier-1 European data (Basel, Oslo, Perpignan, De Bilt), NOT Indian data -- see the project's India-bridge notes before treating this as deployment-ready for Warora/Vidarbha.
Not yet benchmarked for latency/memory on the actual target hardware (Raspberry Pi) -- deferred per the project brief until hardware is available.
Hyperparameters were chosen via a modest, non-exhaustive search (see 05_model_training.ipynb); tuning did not clearly outperform CatBoost's own defaults in that search.

Feature list includes one-hot city columns (city_BASEL, city_OSLO, city_PERPIGNAN, city_DE_BILT) from the 4-city training set. A single deployment site (Warora) will never have any of these set to 1, so this exact model CANNOT be used as-is by Repo B -- retraining on Tier 3 data, without cross-city one-hot features (or with a Warora-specific slot), is required before this is deployable, not just before it is validated.
